Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SkeletronPrime: The hatefull spitit was resurected by a mysterious group of people, and is seeking revenge after the ones who brought it down before...
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TheDestroyer: Tissue from the world's evil fell upon the underworld, consuming dark essence it has regrown itself into a mighty beast that cosumes everything that it sees.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Retinazer: The eye of a great tyrant spying across the land, eradicating its targets from afar.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Spazmatism: The eye of a great tyrant spying across the land, burning down its targets with cursed flames.

Achievements.BUCKETS_OF_BOLTS_Description: Defeat the three Champions of Cthulhu: The Twins, the Hallowed Serpent, and Prime Skeletron.
Achievements.MECHA_MAYHEM_Description: Defeat all three Champions of Cthulhu at once.
Achievements.QUEEN_MACHINE_Description: Defeat The lord of Hell herself!
